title: English Language — Form 2
description: A second-year secondary English course: future and perfect tenses, subject-verb agreement, modal verbs, building and linking sentences, direct speech, vocabulary (synonyms, homophones, idioms), inference in comprehension, descriptive and narrative writing, a formal letter and stress and intonation, with Cameroonian examples and original exercises.
